qa.question: Should the 2029 planned retirement of Sebree units 1 and 2 be removed?
qa.finding: Big Rivers' 2026 integrated resource plan keeps both Sebree units in service through 2050 in the base case. Its only retirement case for the plant is a test case in 2039. The 2023 plan's 2029 retirement and 635 MW combined cycle replacement is not in the 2026 plan.
qa.recommendation: Clear Planned retire on both units, and add a Status Detail entry saying the 2026 plan keeps the plant running. Do not add the combined cycle at the Sebree station.
qa.note: Source is the 2026 plan at https://psc.ky.gov/pscecf/2026-00268/senthia.santana%40bigrivers.com/09292026115438/2026_IRP_Public_Redacted_and_Appendices.pdf. I found no combined cycle sited at the Sebree station in it. Same applies to unit G100001018035. A person should remove the old scheduled retirement event. Both units are covered by this question.

qa.question: Is 2022 the right start year when EIA lists 1979 and 1981?
qa.finding: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx, plant 6639) gives operating years 1979 for unit 1 and 1981 for unit 2. The 2026 plan at https://psc.ky.gov/pscecf/2026-00268/senthia.santana%40bigrivers.com/09292026115438/2026_IRP_Public_Redacted_and_Appendices.pdf says the units were converted to natural gas in 2022.
qa.recommendation: Leave 2022 as the start year, since it is the conversion year on a timepoint 2 row.
qa.note: EIA carries the original coal unit years. Same applies to unit 2.

qa.question: Should the county for the Sebree station be Webster rather than Henderson?
qa.finding: The EIA-860M table and the Kentucky air permit file place the plant in Webster County, at Robards. GEM shows Henderson with city Sebree.
qa.recommendation: Change Local area to Webster and keep the city as Sebree, or leave as is if Sebree mailing address is preferred.
qa.note: Air permit index at https://dep.gateway.ky.gov/eSearch/ lists agency interest 44411 in Webster County.

qa.question: Should fuel oil be added to the Sebree units once the backup fuel case is decided?
qa.finding: Big Rivers' 2026 plan proposes fuel oil backup for Sebree units 1 and 2, in service January 2029. Case 2026-00291 at https://psc.ky.gov/Case/ViewCaseFilings/2026-00291 has only a notice of intent so far, with no application or order.
qa.recommendation: Leave Fuel as fossil gas for now and recheck when the commission rules on case 2026-00291.
qa.note: Same applies to unit G100001018035. The cost is redacted in the public plan.
